valuation.heading: How much is *your home worth?*
valuation.lead: Two ways to find out what your home is worth.

online.title: Online valuation
online.text: A guideline estimate in an instant, with our valuation tool. It is a first reference, not a sale price.

advisor.title: Valuation with an advisor
advisor.text: We visit the property, review its paperwork and analyse the market. We hand you the report and go through it with you.

philosophy.heading: Our *philosophy*
philosophy.text: A single advisor coordinates the paperwork, the viewings, the negotiation and every professional involved. And when something unexpected comes up, our answer is always the same:
philosophy.quote: «Don't worry, I'll take care of it».
